    rm.riskandmarginpivot AS risk_pivot, 
    o.notionsum AS notional_value, 
    ms.volmeter AS volatility_measure, 
    (rm.risk_margin_profile->'margin_rates'->>'margrate')::numeric AS margin_rate,

    orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
